new.s: Who was the Chairman of the First Backward Classes Commission appointed in 1953?
new.x: The First Backward Classes Commission (1953-55) was headed by Kaka Kalelkar; the Second (1979) was headed by B.P. Mandal.

new.s: Who headed the commission set up in October 2017 to examine sub-categorisation of OBCs?
new.x: The Justice G. Rohini Commission (2017) examined sub-categorisation of the Central-list OBCs and reported in July 2023.

new.s: Which Prime Minister's government set up the Second Backward Classes Commission in 1979?
new.x: The Mandal Commission was set up in 1979 by the Janata Government of Morarji Desai; V.P. Singh implemented it in 1990.
new.angle: U0409 PYQ y2533b5205b5 Mandal -> appointing government

new.s: During whose tenure as Prime Minister was the First Backward Classes Commission appointed in 1953?
new.x: The Kaka Kalelkar Commission was appointed by the President on 29 January 1953, when Nehru's government was in office.
new.angle: U0409 PYQ y2533b5205b5 commission -> appointing government

new.s: Which case held that a promotion quota for SCs and STs needs data on backwardness, inadequacy of representation and efficiency?
new.x: In M. Nagaraj (2006) the Supreme Court upheld the 77th, 81st, 82nd and 85th Amendments but required such data before a promotion quota.

new.s: The 103rd Constitutional Amendment Act on EWS reservation was introduced as which Constitution Amendment Bill?
new.x: The 103rd Amendment (10% EWS quota) came from the 124th Bill, 2019; the 102nd came from the 123rd Bill and the 105th from the 127th Bill.

new.s: The 102nd Constitutional Amendment Act, which gave constitutional status to the NCBC, was introduced as which Bill?
new.x: The 102nd Amendment (Article 338B, 342A) was the 123rd Bill; the 103rd was the 124th and the 105th was the 127th.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about EWS eligibility under the 103rd Amendment:
1. Family income must be below Rs 8 lakh a year.
2. The family should not own a flat of 1,000 sq ft or more.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: EWS criteria are family income below Rs 8 lakh, agricultural land below 5 acres and a flat below 1,000 sq ft.

new.s: In which case did the Supreme Court hold in March 2026 that parental salary alone cannot place a candidate in the OBC creamy layer?
o: Union of India v. Rohith Nathan
new.x: In Union of India v. Rohith Nathan (11 March 2026) the Court held parental salary alone cannot decide creamy-layer status and ordered supernumerary posts.
new.angle: U0409 notes gap: Rohith Nathan case -> issue

new.s: Which commission recommended 15 per cent reservation for minorities?
new.x: The Ranganath Misra Commission recommended a 15 per cent quota for minorities.

new.s: Who was appointed Chairperson of the National Commission for Backward Classes in 2026?
new.x: Niranjan Jyoti was appointed NCBC chairperson in 2026; the NCBC became constitutional under Article 338B by the 102nd Amendment.

new.s: In which year was the Ministry of Tribal Affairs set up after being split from the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment?
new.x: The Ministry of Tribal Affairs was created in 1999 out of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.
new.angle: U0410 #7 Ministry of Tribal Affairs -> year

new.s: From which date did the National Commission for Scheduled Tribes start functioning as a separate body?
new.x: The 89th Amendment (2003) split the SC/ST Commission; the separate NCST under Article 338A functions from 19 February 2004.

new.s: Who among the following is associated with the isolation ("national park") approach to tribal policy?
new.x: The early Verrier Elwin argued for keeping tribals apart; Ghurye favoured assimilation and Nehru integration.

new.s:
Match the following:
List-I (Approach)
A. Isolation
B. Assimilation
C. Integration
List-II (Proponent)
1. Jawaharlal Nehru
2. G.S. Ghurye
3. Early Verrier Elwin
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
new.x: Isolation is linked with the early Elwin, assimilation with Ghurye and integration with Nehru.

new.s: In which year was the Special Component Plan for Scheduled Castes, now called DAPSC, started?
new.x: The Special Component Plan began in 1979, was renamed SCSP and is now DAPSC; the TSP began in the Fifth Plan (1974).

new.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Scheduled Tribe status does not depend on the religion a person follows.
2. Parliament can amend the Constitution (Scheduled Tribes) Order, 1950 under Article 342(2).
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: ST status is religiously neutral, unlike SC status, and Article 342(2) lets Parliament change the ST list.
new.angle: U0410 #3 ST identification -> religious neutrality, procedure

new.s: How many villages are covered under the Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyan launched in September 2024?
new.x: Dharti Aaba (DAJGUA) covers about 63,000 villages with Rs 79,156 crore through 17 ministries.

new.s: By which year does the National Sickle Cell Elimination Mission aim to eliminate sickle cell disease?
new.x: The Sickle Cell Mission, run by the Health and Tribal Affairs ministries, targets elimination by 2047.
new.angle: U0410 notes gap: Sickle Cell Mission -> target year

new.s: What is the target number of Eklavya Model Residential Schools to be set up in the country?
new.x: The EMRS target is 740 schools; about 511 were running by August 2026.

new.s: Under which Section of the RTE Act, 2009 does the appropriate Government make rules, such as the State RTE Rules?
new.x: Section 38 lets the appropriate Government make rules; States frame their RTE Rules and admission rules under it.
new.angle: U0411 PYQ yc30ae7748fe RTE -> rule-making by States

new.s:

2. The 2019 amendment to the RTE Act allowed regular examinations in Classes 5 and 8.

new.x: The RTE Act came into force on 1 April 2010; the 2019 amendment brought exams in Classes 5 and 8 and allowed detention after a re-exam.

new.s: Which Article of the Constitution, as substituted by the 86th Amendment, provides for early childhood care and education for children up to six years?
new.x: The 86th Amendment rewrote Article 45 to cover early childhood care and education till age six.

new.s: In which year did India accede to the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child?
